commentary_segments.text: Capacitor aC is now floating. Two more switches are necessary. However, the ratio a will be insensitive to the parasitic junction capacitances. Similar functions are carried out during the two phases. During phase 1, capacitor aC is charged to the input voltage. During phase 2, this capacitor aC is discharged to zero, forcing its charge towards C. Let us now see how the parasitic junction capacitances of all four switches come in. If they do not, the gain A is accurately equal to a. v The operation of this SC integrator is illustrated even better by showing the circuit first with the clocks closed on phase 1, and then on 2.
